backend/main.mo: Defines core backend types and state maps for users, questions, tests, sessions, and suggestions, including authorization and blob-storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report placeholder with no listed features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing various frontend files, their functionality, and implementation status.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading MathJax and mounting the React app with SEO metadata.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application router handling authentication, view restoration, activation transitions, and global metadata setup.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary that displays a fallback UI with options to reload or return home.
frontend/src/components/AverageResultPDF: Disabled placeholder button for exporting average results as a PDF.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Comment interface for questions supporting listing, posting, and admin deletion with React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Responsive site footer with attribution, disclaimer text, and themed styling.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders the main app header with navigation, login/logout handling, and responsive menu UI using identity and profile hooks.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardSecti: Displays overall leaderboard rankings with badges, highlighting the current user and showing loading states.
frontend/src/components/MathContent.tsx: Wraps MathJax rendering for math HTML content, re-typesetting on content or theme changes.
frontend/src/components/PerTestResultPDF: Disabled placeholder button for exporting full per-test result PDFs.
frontend/src/components/PerTestScoreOnly: Disabled placeholder button for exporting score‑only PDFs for a test.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Dialog for creating a user profile with form fields and submission via saveProfile hook.
frontend/src/components/QuestionDetailsD: Placeholder dialog showing a question ID and indicating future full question details implementation.
Filterable, searchable question gallery with selection, admin deletion workflow, and chapter/difficulty filters.
frontend/src/components/ResultListPDFExp: Disabled placeholder button for exporting a PDF of a results list.
frontend/src/components/ScheduleTestDial: Dialog for selecting start and end times for a test, validating input, and submitting schedule updates.
frontend/src/components/ShareButtons.tsx: Provides WhatsApp and Telegram share buttons that open platform-specific share links with preset text.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionModera: Admin panel for viewing, scrolling, and deleting user suggestions with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionSectio: User-facing feedback form allowing text submission with character limits and async mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Placeholder component indicating future user management interface functionality.
frontend/src/components/ViewActivationOv: Displays a full-screen loading overlay when the app is activating a specific view.
frontend/src/components/YouTubeSubscript: Gate screen prompting users to subscribe on YouTube and verify subscription before unlocking tests.
frontend/src/contexts/ViewActivationCont: Context managing activation state for views with safety timeouts and helper methods to start, finish, or cancel activation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrappedCaller: Tracks and syncs the caller's role between backend and locally bootstrapped storage, exposing admin status and role readiness.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, stored identity loading, and identity state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user data via the actor, including profile and comment conversions between backend and local formats.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode palettes, and Radix overlay behavior.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the app root, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with platform story, mission, and UI components while reporting view activation.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Displays an admin-only panel with loading, access control, and placeholder admin features.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Loads user profile, role, and test configs, handling loading, errors, and dashboard display with retries.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page with hero content and login/start-test flow that redirects authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/ResultPage.tsx: Placeholder results page showing a basic card layout for future test result details.
frontend/src/pages/TestInterface.tsx: Placeholder test-taking interface showing a card where full test functionality will be implemented.
frontend/src/types/local.ts: Defines local TypeScript interfaces and enums for user profiles, questions, tests, and leaderboard data.
frontend/src/utils/questionPdfExport.ts: Provides placeholder functions for exporting questions to PDF and generating previews.
frontend/src/utils/roleBootstrap.ts: Handles localStorage persistence and retrieval of user roles for faster admin UI loading.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing) and persist them in sessionStorage, with optional clearing and precedence handling.
frontend/src/utils/viewPersistence.ts: Stores and retrieves the last viewed app screen in sessionStorage, including separate tracking for non-test views.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining content paths, theme extensions, custom colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s state and pending backend API work needed to satisfy frontend expectations, with incremental deployment guidance.
